decision: The exact frozen minimal source design is constructible under its explicitly bounded selected-source and trusted-operating premises. No concrete source-design defect was found in the inspected closure. The author may implement this design within the existing source-only authorization; this review accepts no implementation, stage adoption, execution, reference payload, scientific outcome or completed custody.

findings_by_boundary.finding: The guard necessarily supplies --output and --lanes. A separate integration adapter can check that exact tail and then execute the original producer with only --frozen-root/--reference/--mode profile/--output. Root exposes ModuleType, original compile/exec and the actual capability/API injected into the adapter. Fresh producer __main__ namespace and exact bootstrap object forwarding preserve the source executor premise. Producer location under baseline resolves its authority mount to stage/areas/cache-validity/cold_authority_v7.py. Ordinary return follows the producer-owned marker/restoration/cold2/export path; adapter must not intercept that marker or call internals to manufacture success.
findings_by_boundary.topic: Adapter compatibility and actual initial ownership

findings_by_boundary.finding: Private one-attempt state retains the actual Popen, generation, wait result and original failure before any serialized evidence is consumed. Exact clean argv/environment and stage/job selection are source derivations. The parent queue lease is separate from original science.lock, avoiding a self-deadlock. START, canonical receipt, usage and all raw logs are joined to that live invocation; missing receipts remain missing and guard PASS alone cannot qualify. Static AST comparisons confirmed the exact START and receipt key lists.
findings_by_boundary.topic: Parent P01-P05 invocation and original evidence join

findings_by_boundary.finding: The design uses only the bounded process/generation/pidfd observation pattern, with explicit corrections for denied or ambiguous observations and failed closes. The selected producer profile skips candidate native construction and uses same-process original CLI execution. Successful closure relies on the stated trusted selected-source, OS/interpreter/stdlib and cooperating-parent premises; it is not inferred universally from /proc emptiness or a process-group kill. Unexplained processes or unknown cleanup remain nonqualifying. Fresh retained-domain creation after cleanup and no inherited retained-domain descriptors are constructible under those premises.

Both original exports are mandatory. Complete bounded nofollow/dirfd reads, full mode/identity/link checks, joint repeated snapshots, exclusive retained copies, known close/fsync/readback and source-owned final checks supply the required custody predicate. Root hashing alone is explicitly insufficient for full mode/final-path checks, and the design supplements it. Original and retained FileRecords remain distinct. Parent manifests are emitted from actual private observations; caller booleans or orphan common files cannot qualify.
findings_by_boundary.topic: P06-P08 complete pair retention and sealing

findings_by_boundary.finding: AST comparisons confirmed the common envelope, diagnostic envelope, diagnostic snapshot keys, scientific pins, original-driver pin and authority pin. The common prefix has ten members and preserves exact original code/return/certificate/stdout/suffix data. Strict JSON rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite JSON tokens, booleans used as integers and unknown fields; full lowercase hex and complete payload hashes are checked. Diagnostics retain cumulative complement receipts and absent native/cache bindings without becoming a new scientific equality oracle.
findings_by_boundary.topic: Exact pair schema, primitive grammar and source/workload joins

findings_by_boundary.finding: Authentic initially captured Root/capability/API and source-owned operation aliases remain the entry premise, rather than function shape or restored JSON objects. The consumer requires the independently source-selected manifest and publication record plus both complete retained exports, then jointly rechecks them after decoding. Existing G12_REFERENCE_HANDOFF is actually None at line 12; proposed source selections also remain None. Future output digests and actual launch/outcome values are legitimate future results, not prerequisites for authoring this closed source design.
findings_by_boundary.topic: Cold consumer and closed source selection

findings_by_boundary.finding: The adapter preserves the producer primary and traceback, restores only owned argv/module slots, and treats any restoration/currentness/secondary error as non-success. Parent failures similarly retain primary and ordered secondary evidence and require bounded known cleanup; Popen failure or partial exports never produce a substitute canonical receipt or seal. Unknown close prevents qualification, including failures after manifest bytes have been written.
findings_by_boundary.topic: First failure, ordered secondaries and P09 cleanup

findings_by_boundary.finding: Original 180-second, phase-cap, 1-GiB and stream/usage limits remain requirements. New finite file/parser ceilings are rejection limits and do not grant memory, time or proof that payloads fit. All parent/adapter/reference/cleanup/retention/manifest and later consumer costs remain charged, without adding nested phase timings as disjoint costs. The publication record covers through its pre-write point and separately authorized enclosing source-owned completion must cover its write/readback/close and source-adoption tail. Missing actual accounting ownership leaves selection None. No self-report substitutes for that final join.
findings_by_boundary.topic: Finite limits and complete cost tail

implementation_review_focus: Implement only the three fixed G12 leaves and source-only metadata/stage derivations described by this packet; keep runtime source selections None.

Preserve all complete original and retained pair/raw evidence and actual tail accounting joins; never infer completion from available manifest bytes.
